summary: Iteration 3 (real OAuth for Shopee + TikTok): 37/37 pytest pass (24 new OAuth tests in /app/backend/tests/test_oauth.py + 13 iteration-2 regressions). Verified: Shopee /oauth/start builds https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/shop/auth_partner with partner_id+timestamp+64-char lowercase-hex HMAC-SHA256 sign (recomputed independently from partner_key and matched exactly) and a redirect that embeds a JWT state (sid+p+exp); TikTok /oauth/start builds https://services.tiktokshop.com/open/authorize?app_key=..&state=<JWT>; 400 when partner_id/partner_key missing, 401 unauthenticated, 404 unknown store. Callbacks: missing params / error param -> 303 to FRONTEND_STORES_URL?connect=error&msg=..; bad JWT -> HTTP 400 'Invalid state'; platform mismatch (p=tiktok on shopee callback) -> 400 'Platform mismatch in state'; expired state rejected; valid state + dummy code -> 303 connect=error with real marketplace error and connection_status persisted as 'error'. POST /stores/{id}/test reaches the REAL Shopee API (returned 'Wrong sign.' and 'Request Source IP (35.225.230.28) is undeclared...' -> proves real signed HTTP call) with ok=false/connection_status='error' persisted; 400 without access_token; 401 unauthenticated. _ensure_fresh_token no-ops safely with expired token + null refresh_token. StoreOut exposes connection_status/last_verified_at/token_expires_at/shop_cipher and leaks neither partner_key nor access_token; PATCH accepts partner_id/partner_key/shop_id/sync_enabled/is_active and persists. Regressions OK (/api/login, dashboard/metrics, orders + detail, labels PDF, inventory + threshold PATCH, webhooks/orders, settings, both CSV exports). Frontend: connection_status badges match API for all 4 stores; Shopee modal labels Partner ID/Partner Key, TikTok App Key/App Secret; authorize button disabled + yellow warning banner when creds empty, enabled after entering creds; clicking Connect/Authorize does PATCH /api/stores/{id} then GET /oauth/start then navigates to partner.shopeemobile.com (Shopee) / services.tiktokshop.com (TikTok) URLs (intercepted, not followed); Test Connection POSTs /stores/{id}/test and shows real error toast ('Wrong sign.') with the card badge flipping to ERROR. Two HIGH frontend defects found (post-callback toast never renders; Test Connection button vanishes once status != active) and two HIGH backend defects (TikTok API paths/host wrong; unvalidated null credentials leak raw Python errors). DB state for stores 1-4 reset to partner_id/partner_key/shop_id=null, connection_status='disconnected'.

critical.issue: TikTok endpoints are wrong so the flow can never succeed even with real credentials. get_authorized_shops calls TIKTOK_API_BASE + '/api/seller/global/user/shops' and the live API replies 'Invalid path. The specified path does not match any available endpoint.' Correct path is GET /authorization/202309/shops on https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com. Token exchange also posts to TIKTOK_API_BASE + '/api/v2/token/get', but the v2 token endpoint lives on a different host: https://auth.tiktok-shops.com/api/v2/token/get (add e.g. TIKTOK_AUTH_API_BASE env var). Verified against live TikTok responses.

No validation of partner_id/partner_key/shop_id before signing, so raw Python exceptions are surfaced to the user as the 'error' detail: store with access_token but no partner_key -> "'NoneType' object has no attribute 'encode'" (shopee) and "unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'NoneType' and 'str'" (tiktok); shopee store without shop_id -> Shopee returns 'There is no shop_id in query.'. Should return 400 with a clear message (e.g. 'Partner credentials / shop not configured').

minor.issue: Invalid/expired/mismatched state raises HTTPException(400) so the browser lands on a raw JSON error page instead of being redirected to FRONTEND_STORES_URL?connect=error. Prefer _frontend_redirect('error', ...) for all state failures.

exchange_code/refresh_access_token call _safe_json(r) twice (double JSON parse) and get_authorized_shops treats a missing 'code' field (None) as success, so a malformed response would be reported as connected.
app_secret is sent in the JSON body; TikTok v2 token/get expects app_key/app_secret as query params on the auth host. Worth re-checking against the official doc when real credentials exist.

ui_bugs.issue: Test Connection button disappears as soon as connection_status != 'active'. isAuthorized = store.access_token || connection_status === 'active', but StoreOut never returns access_token, so after the first failed test (which sets status='error') the user can no longer retry Test Connection even though a token exists. Expose an is_authorized/has_token boolean on StoreOut and use it.

No field to enter/edit shop_id, yet the Shopee Test Connection call requires it ('There is no shop_id in query.' when null). Users who did not complete the OAuth handshake have no way to set it from the UI.

integration_issues.issue: Toast NEVER renders on the OAuth return trip. Loading /stores?connect=success&msg=Shopee%20Main%20SG or connect=error&msg=... cleans the query params and re-fetches /api/stores (proven: 3x GET /api/stores) but no [data-sonner-toast] ever appears (15s poll, both success and error). Sonner works fine for later interactions (Test Connection and Slack save toasts render). Root cause: toast() is called from Stores' first-mount useEffect, which runs before the sibling <Toaster/> in App.js subscribes to the sonner store, so the toast is dropped. Result: after returning from Shopee/TikTok the user gets zero feedback. Fix by deferring the toast (setTimeout 0 / requestAnimationFrame) or gating it on a mounted flag.

action_items: Fix TikTok API host/paths: token exchange -> https://auth.tiktok-shops.com/api/v2/token/get (new env var), authorized shops -> GET /authorization/202309/shops on open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com
Validate partner_id/partner_key (and shop_id for Shopee) in POST /stores/{id}/test and return 400 instead of leaking Python TypeError/AttributeError strings
Fix the post-callback sonner toast race in Stores.jsx so connect=success/error actually shows a toast
Expose is_authorized (or has_access_token) on StoreOut so the Test Connection button stays available after a failed test
Redirect (instead of raw 400 JSON) on invalid/expired/mismatched OAuth state
Optionally allow editing shop_id in the Manage Connection modal
critical_code_review_comments: Shopee signing verified correct: HMAC-SHA256(partner_key, partner_id + path + timestamp) recomputed in tests matched the returned sign byte-for-byte; shop-signed base correctly appends access_token + shop_id.

JWT state is signed with JWT_SECRET, carries sid/p/exp (15 min) and is platform-checked — good. Note the state is embedded in the Shopee redirect URI, so the redirect URI must be whitelisted with a wildcard/query-tolerant match in the Shopee console or the real handshake will be rejected.

Carry-over from iteration 2 still unfixed: shopee_sync._sync_cycle uses asyncio.run() inside the running loop; the worker currently only logs 'missing credentials or not authorized', so the crash path is untested. Do not enable sync_enabled on a store until this is addressed.

POST /stores/{id}/test swallows every exception into a 200 with ok=false — genuine programming errors (TypeError) are indistinguishable from marketplace errors. Log the traceback and only translate the platform-specific exception types (ShopeeError/TikTokError/httpx errors) into the error payload.

success_rate.backend: 100% (37/37 automated assertions pass; 2 HIGH defects found outside assertion scope via manual probes)

seed_data_creation: No new rows. Temporarily set partner_id/partner_key/shop_id on stores 1, 2, 3 and connection_status='active' on store 1; all reset afterwards to partner_id=null, partner_key=null, shop_id=null, connection_status='disconnected' for stores 1-4. Seeded placeholder access_tokens (sh_main_token etc.) left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite /app/backend/tests/test_oauth.py (24 tests) uses store 1 = shopee, store 3 = tiktok, sets dummy partner creds via PATCH and resets them in the session fixture teardown. Real Shopee API is reachable from this sandbox (returns 'Wrong sign.' / IP-not-whitelisted), TikTok returns 'Invalid path' due to the wrong path in the client. To exercise the Test Connection button in the UI you must first set stores.connection_status='active' in the DB (button visibility currently depends on it) — see frontend HIGH issue. Toast assertions must use [data-sonner-toast] and be checked within ~4s (sonner auto-dismiss).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Post-callback toast loss: React runs child effects before sibling <Toaster/> mounts/subscribes to the sonner store, so toast() invoked in Stores' initial useEffect (triggered by ?connect= params) is published to zero subscribers and discarded; the effect still runs (params cleaned, stores refetched), proving the code path executes. 2) Test Connection button vanishing: isAuthorized relies on store.access_token which StoreOut deliberately omits, leaving connection_status==='active' as the only signal; a failed test sets 'error' and hides the retry button. 3) TikTok flow: paths verified wrong against the live API ('Invalid path'), and the v2 token endpoint is hosted on auth.tiktok-shops.com, not open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com. 4) Unvalidated null credentials propagate into hmac/string concatenation, surfacing raw Python error text as the user-facing 'error' detail.
